description:
Hi! I'm the Team Leader & Researcher. We have a non-traditional Synthetic Biology project: reprogramming a destructive plant pathogen into a smart bio-fertilizer using Genetic Logic Gates (IF/THEN) & a Kill Switch.
Our team is almost complete! We already have a Front-end Developer, UX/UI Designer, and a Presenter. We are only missing a Data Analyst/Scientist to handle agricultural data, build a simulation, or analyze the biological impact for our dashboard.
